narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate on the landing book-map: the Pandoran forest read as a cathedral — a single colossal Hometree soaring out of a tiered forest, daylight falling through the vaulted canopy in long shafts, the one image that says 'this forest has floors.'
subject: A single immense Pandoran Hometree rising from the centre of a dense forest, its trunk made of many braided woody columns fused into one vast pillar; tiers of foliage stack up its height from a dim glowing forest floor through a shaded mid-level into a bright crown; long pale shafts of daylight break downward through gaps in the high canopy like light through cathedral windows; a few tiny winged creatures wheel near the sunlit crown for scale.
scene: A grand interior-of-the-forest vista at the base of a giant tree, the eye drawn upward through stacked layers of leaf and light.
camera: A low, slightly upward-tilted wide view from near the forest floor, emphasising the tree's height and the vertical stacking of layers.
light: Warm-cool daylight breaking through the high canopy in distinct god-rays, brightest at the crown and dimming downward into a cool, faintly bioluminescent floor.
palette: Void-indigo and deep teal shadow at the floor, cool Pandora cyan and living teal through the mid-canopy, pale luminous light shafts from above.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, luminous and atmospheric, observed-from-life confidence.
detail_level: Crisp on the great trunk and the nearer foliage tiers; softening into haze and light toward the high crown.
composition: The Hometree trunk anchoring the centre, layers receding upward, light shafts crossing the frame diagonally, dark floor foreground for the plate to breathe.
consistency_notes: Landscape/architecture plate, no prominent figures. Cool Pandora palette with the cathedral-of-light mood that anchors the whole chapter.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
